## Purpose and scope
Linked issue, contribution track, affected task/asset IDs, exact change:

## Evidence and boundaries
Source facts versus authored choices, access/rights, unresolved gaps, actor/evaluator separation:

## Verification
Commands and actual results, tested revision, screenshots if applicable, failed/skipped/unavailable checks:

## Compatibility and readiness
Changed IDs/interfaces, affected consumers, claimed readiness, remaining blockers and requested reviewer expertise:

## Paper-conversion review (required when task design changes)

Link the task package/role manifest, planning walkthrough and conversion review record (PTR-01 through PTR-08). Include coverage units/denominators, evidence locators, exact reviewed hashes, blockers and the gates requiring re-review after this change. If this contribution does not change task design, state why this section is not applicable.

- [ ] Source coverage and required final states lead to explicit dependencies, resource/specimen allocation and valid reference routes
- [ ] Robot perception/motion/manipulation, inferred missing steps, choices/loops and failure/closeout paths are explicit
- [ ] Saved artifact roles, schemas, visibility and template/episode/campaign distinctions are documented
- [ ] Source package, asset bindings, actor/evaluator projections, viewer adapter and actual validation results support the claimed scope

## Equipment reconstruction review (required when equipment changes)

Link the equipment review record or equivalent evidence and its field mapping. For a contribution with no equipment changes, state why this section is not applicable.

- [ ] Real equipment identity/configuration and dated product/manual/dimension/CAD searches are documented
- [ ] Matched reference/model views, dimensions/inferences and discrepancies support the actual appearance and structure
- [ ] Robot operations map to the required parts, access, observations and state changes; omitted handling is reconstructed
- [ ] Exact model revision/hashes and actual reviewer decisions support the claimed fidelity and interaction readiness
- [ ] Missing evidence, draft proxies and functional/collision/reachability limits remain explicit; static checks do not grant fidelity acceptance

Review the [contributor checklist](https://github.com/openags/ScienceGym/blob/main/docs/contributing/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md) before submission.
